change: drawPaint retains one replay-local scratch canvas for ordinary fill/brush/pencil/eraser strokes. Reset transform, alpha, compositing and pixels before each reuse; release it in outer finally. Clone and live Clone-source paths retain separate surfaces. Sampling geometry, per-stroke opacity and ordering are unchanged.
fixture: Five layers at 698x396 with 40 soft brush strokes on the top layer; first document was built without being rendered, followed by 19 warm tab switches. Production Chromium, Canvas2D.
results: First switch 83→68.3 ms, repeat 68 ms. Warm medians 11.8→12.2/11.7 ms. Recorded long task 68→60 ms in both trials, still above the routine 50 ms target.
limitations: Modest cold-replay improvement; UI blocking is not solved. Long replay still needs profiling/cooperative scheduling or further rendering work.
validation: 29 browser cases and 702 unit tests passed; new comparison renders the same mixed strokes together versus fresh per-stroke surfaces at multiple scales and an affine transform, with exact RGBA equality.
